name: barbell strict curl
description: A barbell curl done with no body swing, so the biceps do all of the work. It is a simple way to build the front of the upper arm.
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and your torso still.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight.
